children: UC Automotive filed for an initial public offering.
The Canadian used-car dealership plans to trade on Nasdaq, but didn't disclose the amount or pricing of the shares it intends to offer.
UC Automotive is based in Richmond, British Columbia, and its business is focused on the Greater Vancouver area.
Revenue in 2025 was $37.5 million and UC sold 1,128 vehicles. The average sales price was $32,581.
